verdict.rationale: Codegen agents can fix bugs and open pull requests, and the API/SDK lets you trigger agents programmatically, including from CI/CD. A security/secrets scan is documented only as part of PR review. There is no documented flow that ingests security alerts, validates them and remediates them automatically, so an engineering lead would have to wire alerts into agent runs through the API. Missing for 10: native security-alert ingestion (e.g. Dependabot or code-scanning alerts), an automated validation/triage step, a documented end-to-end alert-to-PR workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
